newsitem.title: USA: IFR Systems launches new analyzers.
newsitem.headline: IFR Systems launches new analyzers.

text.p: IFR Systems Inc said Monday it introduced its AN1800 Series spectrum analyzers, which it will begin shipping to customers in July.
The new products replace the AN900 Series spectrum analyzers.

"We expect this exciting new product family to be well received by our customers for use in the lab, factory and field, and anticipate that it will stimulate growth in this segment of our business," Alfred Hunt III, president and chief executive officer of IFR Systems, sid in a statement.
Hunt said IFR's spectrum analyzers are used in wireless communications to test and verify a range of radio frequency standards, including electro-magnetic interference.
